subject: [PATCH] nfsd: fix out-of-bounds read of sv_permsocks when starting a thread

reviews.author: NeilBrown
reviews.summary: reviewer noted that most services don't use svc_create_pooled(), only nfsd, and suggested adding a 'struct net*' arg to svc_create_pooled() to store the network pointer in serv->sv_net
reviews.raw_body:
Most services don't use svc_create_pooled() either - only nfsd.
I would add a 'struct net*' arg to svc_create_pooled() and
store it in serv->sv_net as you suggest.

Thanks,
NeilBrown

reviews.author: Deepanshu Kartikey
reviews.summary: reviewer noted that sv_stats field always points to nfsd_net, suggesting an alternative approach to avoid extra locking
reviews.raw_body:
Thanks Jeff and Neil, for the review. I will make the changes and
submit patch v2 shortly.

Thanks

Deepanshu

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch fixes an out-of-bounds read issue in the nfsd kernel module when starting a thread. The problem occurs because the code attempts to access the sv_permsocks field of the rqstp->rq_server structure without checking if it's valid. To fix this, the patch introduces a helper function that allows accessing the nfsd_net structure through the rqstp->rq_server->sv_stats field, avoiding the need for extra locking and socket lists.
